summary: Integrated all six v19 audit findings files into the product. docs/audit/v19/CORRECTIONS.md is the ledger for ALL 266 findings (68 applied, 38 rejected with named reasons, 63 open with measured causes, 97 positive verifications; zero fall-throughs, findings files untouched). Code/data edits across 28 src files + package.json: (1) landed the v17 vessel-contour handoff (SectionCanvas now appends registryVesselParts()) and the #mirror slug resolution so the 12 mirrored nerve + 38 mirrored vessel contours are painted in 2D/PiP, not discarded; (2) WCAG 2.5.3 accessible names on the four All-module buttons; (3) a11y/AA fixes: role=group on the canvas wrapper (was a role=img atom that hid its own toolbar), aria-current on tree row + level ruler, PiP glyph buttons named, listbox children are options, CT select + range labels, focus ring restored on the search box, --text-muted 3.44->5.42:1, new --border-interactive 3.26:1, dimmed tree row 5.12:1, --sidebar-w at <=1024px, header reflow at <=640px; (4) rendering: vessel tubes settle at the arterial 0.5 opacity, the shared frame driver is really single-owner (was per-instance, 149x per frame), one reachable ellipsoid-suppression guard (dead duplicate removed), retired section-capping registry documented, two uncalled exports deleted; (5) data: ACoA + thalamogeniculate supply de-links, AChA territory gains nuc-subthalamic, built-in course supply ids that resolved to no card emptied, synonym identity claims removed, somatotopy order 7->8, 12 nerve context notes re-pointed at the authored course, IML laterality/placement, plate-thalamus-mid + plate-tel-sagittal-hemisphere frame letters corrected against my own measurements; (6) verify:audit-facts wired into package.json (D5) and its two red data defects fixed -> 49/49. Verification: full 29-command non-browser sweep run twice; 26 exit 0 including validate (0 errors 0 warnings), check, build, verify:pipeline, manifest budget 138 parts/13.8151 MiB/599,204 tris, verify:audit-facts, all vessel/nerve/cortical/pip/a11y/boundary gates. Three gates are red by design and handed to final-review as D7 gate-flips (3 area-toggles pins: the two WCAG pins + the pinned-open vessel handoff; 1 vessel-render pin invalidated by the dead-guard removal) - listed with exact assertion text in CORRECTIONS.md section 2. Two gates cannot execute in this sandbox (verify:anatomy, verify:imaging-fit: spawnSync EPERM, measured cause = piped child stdio denied, powershell is on PATH; fix belongs to scripts/verify = final-review) and are reported as unverifiable-here, never claimed green.
